language_task: Pick up the green cucumber and remove it from the bowl.
outcome_evidence: Frame 0 in wrist_cam shows the green cucumber inside the bowl. Following approach and alignment, frames 165–185 in wrist_cam and right_base_cam show the cucumber retained between the fingers and lifted clear of the bowl. Frames 212–220 show its release onto the tabletop outside the bowl; frames 230–240 in left_base_cam, right_base_cam and wrist_cam confirm it remains outside as the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, damaging contact or other clear unintended side effect is visible.
